name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px #005fcc outer ring with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators. This ensures 7:1 contrast against dark backgrounds while remaining visible on light ones, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA for all users. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings than minimal standards, but this prevents focus rings from disappearing on high-contrast or color-blind modes.

name: Reader
text: The 4px #005fcc ring risks blending into light patterned backgrounds where #005fcc is the dominant hue. A 3px #000 ring with 2px white inset meets WCAG 2.2 AA on all backgrounds and stays visible. Settle by testing on EXCAVA’s actual backgrounds with a color contrast analyzer.
